capabilities: Set passwords on notes and folders
Hide files by changing their extension
Restore hidden files to .md with a command
disambiguation: Not encryption: files are only renamed so any system text editor can still read them.
extras: Author states files are not encrypted and plans to test real encryption; recommends ignoring .md files in sync setups like Syncthing.
intentEvidence: Oliver for File Hider plugin. This plugin uses some code from it like for hiding folders and context menu.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep journals or other notes hidden from search, graph view, and casual viewers.

relations.evidence: Oliver for File Hider plugin. This plugin uses some code from it

summary: Password protection that hides notes and folders by renaming their extension, unlocking them per session after entering a password.
